name: Parallax Intro
description: Full-screen WebGL intro where floating image planes fly in with a rounded reveal, tilt with the pointer, and drift away on scroll, above a title and a highlighted statement paragraph.
contents: Title, subtitle and gradient replay button
Eight WebGL image planes, some blurred, in a fixed full-screen canvas
Statement paragraph with gradient highlighted phrases
behavior: Planes reveal with a rounded mask and rotate in on load, staggered by delay
Camera orbits slightly following the pointer on screens 480px and wider
Planes fly outward as the page scrolls
Replay button restarts the intro animation

props.name: subtitle
props.default: A creative team crafting digital experiences

props.name: paragraphText
props.default: We build {{highlight}}considered digital products{{/highlight}} for teams who care about the details, blending {{highlight}}design{{/highlight}} and {{highlight}}engineering{{/highlight}} into one seamless process.

editableByProps: Images, plane positions, sizes, blur and delays
Title, subtitle, button label and paragraph text with highlight markers
Background, text and gradient accent colors
Camera, pointer tilt and animation timing and exit distances

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the reveal shape or blur quality
Change the layout of the text blocks
needsCodeEdit.where: header and section elements in the returned JSX

fixed: Uses page scroll position to drive the exit animation, so the page must be taller than the viewport
Canvas is fixed to the viewport behind the content
Needs one image per plane in planeLayout
